projects.name: School of Shaolin Kung Fu
projects.shortDescription: This piece was created as a stained glass adaptation of the School of Shaolin Kung Fu’s logo. The goal was not to redesign, but to accurately represent it in glass.

projects.name: 3 Teir Compase
projects.shortDescription: A three-part stained-glass window built around a large blue-and-black compass, a smaller clover, and a red-and-blue rose heart.

projects.name: 3D Clover
projects.shortDescription: A three-dimensional four-leaf clover that evolved from a dream-catcher concept into an outdoor hanging stained-glass piece.

projects.name: Coat Of Arms
projects.shortDescription: A stained-glass interpretation of my personal coat of arms, combining family colors and symbols with dragons, phoenixes, a crown, clouds, and an etched motto.

projects.name: Fammily Symbls
projects.shortDescription: A small stained-glass family window using five symbols etched into mirror, with personalized corner colors and a central family symbol.
